t: Farming Life in Another World: Birth
d: Hiraku's second chance was just the beginning  as he reflects on the changes that occurred since his arrival, one thing is certain: The Great Tree Village is lively as always.

t: I've Somehow Gotten Stronger When I Improved My Farm-Related Skills
d: Al Wayne, a young farmer, lives peacefully in the countryside growing his vegetables. However, things change when his farming skills reach their maximum level and an army of demons attacks the kingdom.

t: I've Somehow Gotten Stronger When I Improved My Farm-Related Skills
d: When Al enters the forest to collect herbs for his first quest, he does not know he will encounter a super-rare creature with whom he must fight an intense battle in times to come.

d: Al listens to Rai's story, and it becomes evident that Ouroboros is a threat to Helen more than anyone else. What follows is a fight that shows how evil disappears in the face of forgiveness, hope, and love.

t: I've Somehow Gotten Stronger When I Improved My Farm-Related Skills
st: The Farmer and the Life That Was Saved
d: Help arrives at an opportune moment after Ouroboros possesses Helen and almost kills Al. Shortly, the battle enters its decisive phase and an air of uncertainty clouds everything.

t: I've Somehow Gotten Stronger When I Improved My Farm-Related Skills
d: Al and his savior Ruri arrive in Lurugus with different things on their minds. They are unaware that a sneaky demon is lying there in wait to ensnare them.

st: The Farmer and the Hero Who Can't Become a Hero
d: After seeing his eccentric family again and buying some fertilizer from Rulgus, Al returns to the capital with his new travel partner, Ruri. However, she is nowhere to be found.

t: I've Somehow Gotten Stronger When I Improved My Farm-Related Skills
st: The Farmer and the Princess's Resolve
d: After getting wind of an elaborate conspiracy surrounding the recent monster attacks, Al sets the wheels in motion to take down the culprit prince who is promised to Fal-Ys.

t: I've Somehow Gotten Stronger When I Improved My Farm-Related Skills
d: Fal decides to marry Nedils, the prince of the Kingdom of Antisburg, who saved Meigis with his legendary sword. However, Al, Ruri and Helen learn from Luccia that he is the instigator of the monster attacks.

t: I've Somehow Gotten Stronger When I Improved My Farm-Related Skills
d: A painful incident from the past explains Al's never-ending obsession with farming. He owes his life to an orphaned girl who was taken in by his parents.

t: I've Somehow Gotten Stronger When I Improved My Farm-Related Skills
d: Al takes corrective action after getting to the bottom of the strange happenings in Linea's town. However, the primary reason why he agreed to visit is his interest in a locally grown vegetable.

t: I've Somehow Gotten Stronger When I Improved My Farm-Related Skills
st: The Farmer and the Reunion at the Demon King Castle
d: Navigating his way across troubled waters, Al is in for a rude shock when he arrives at the castle to drop off the demon king's precious daughter.

t: I've Somehow Gotten Stronger When I Improved My Farm-Related Skills
st: The Farmer and the New Resolution
d: After an unsettling encounter at the castle, Al cannot stop thinking about the connection between his tragic past and a mysterious evil force.
